items.q: But, Cat was in the band that left and went to Maine.

ctx.x: But, Cat was in the band that left and went to Maine. Plus this fellow -- Julius Walker -- who was a trombone player. These guys were outstanding, you know, musicians in the Orphanage. So, they took the best band with them, you know, for this particular tour.
Yeah. Well, listen. Let's get back to that session just for a minute.
